0022600007.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (1-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) host the Denver Nuggets in the Thunder's second game of the season, and Denver has not yet played a 2026-27 game. Oklahoma City will be without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though Denver beat them 127-107 in their last meeting on April 10, 2026 in Denver.
